reason: A DSH web plugin whose primary purpose is playing and controlling NetEase Cloud Music through an embedded browser player, local API service, account login, and AI playback commands.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页版提供网易云音乐播放器，支持搜索、歌单、歌词、播放队列、扫码登录和对话式播放控制。
summaries.en: A DSH web plugin that provides a NetEase Cloud Music player with search, playlists, lyrics, queue management, QR-code login, and conversational playback control.

capabilities: Provides a browser-based NetEase Cloud Music player with playback controls, playlists, search, lyrics, queue, and history
Starts and manages a local NeteaseCloudMusicApi service
Supports QR-code login and persists account session state locally
Registers an AI tool for searching music and controlling playback
